question: After holding the actual lane's first-trade sniper-window anchor and window length constant, can every same-path executed-entry mismatch be assigned by the frozen attribution priority while transport, account provenance, baseline control, and sniper-anchor control remain gap-safe?

gateDecisionComparator.name: same_instant_account_enriched_window_aligned_helius_state_with_actual_lane_context_and_controlled_sniper_anchor
gateDecisionComparator.positionSemantics: An active position does not suppress a PAPER_SHADOWED gate pass; gate agreement measures WOULD_ENTER versus WOULD_SKIP.
gateDecisionComparator.marketFeatureSemantics: PumpPortal decisions retain PumpPortal tape-derived features and Helius counterfactuals retain Helius tape-derived features. The actual lane's first-trade sniper-window anchor and window length are held constant while Helius buyers are recomputed inside that exact interval.
gateDecisionComparator.gatePathTreatment: Cross-guard-path gate results remain visible as full counterfactual outcomes and are never fed into strategy.

sniperWindowAnchorControl.comparableRule: Actual and shadow anchored flags, first-trade anchor timestamps, anchor kinds, and window lengths must match exactly. Rows without the consumed control are incomparable.
sniperWindowAnchorControl.sourceLineageRule: PumpPortal and Helius producer labels remain different and visible, but source-label difference alone is not an anchor-definition mismatch.

entryMismatchAttribution.passRule: At least one comparable same-path executed ENTRY and one same-path mismatch must be observed. Every mismatch must have one deterministic allowed primary cause. All contributing causes remain visible, and zero mismatches or cross-path-only samples are insufficient evidence.
entryMismatchAttribution.walletIdentityDefinition: A wallet feature disagreement or uniqueBuyerCount/capture disagreement is wallet identity coverage; correlated score differences remain visible as contributing residual state but do not outrank the wallet cause.
entryMismatchAttribution.sniperAnchorDefinition: Anchor-definition differences are comparator-control failures and make the row incomparable under V13. Producer-source labels remain provenance only and cannot create this cause.
entryMismatchAttribution.residualDefinition: Any remaining causal market or guard input difference not assigned to wallet identity.
entryMismatchAttribution.positionStatePolicy: Use actual pre-observation position context as a held-constant control.
entryMismatchAttribution.guardPathPolicy: Different selected guard-override families are scope-incomparable and excluded before attribution.

methodologyBoundary.reason: V12 earned a mechanically valid attribution pass, but both mismatches carried three contributing causes and all 7181 comparable rows used first_trade on the actual lane versus first_referenced_trade on the shadow lane. The systematic anchor-definition defect prevents causal interpretation of the primary-cause ordering.

classifierEpoch.primaryCauseSelection: Inherit the frozen V12 priority after excluding sniper-anchor control failures; sniper producer-source differences are provenance only.
classifierEpoch.contributingCausePolicy: Record every detected contributing cause even when only one primary cause grades attribution.

nextIfPass: Keep Helius report-only and repeat under the unchanged V13 contract before proposing a wallet-identity experiment, provider routing, or strategy consumption.
nextIfFail: Fix only the demonstrated V13 instrumentation defect. Do not change strategy, freshness bounds, gates, exits, capacity, or provider routing.
